text.offer: Past the bandit country lies Berg, a city of its own with its own king, Aaron Leone. Meridian should have friends there. Find the city and take this to the king.
text.progress: Berg lies past the hills and the trader's route, beyond the bandit country.
text.complete: Duke Akardius sends greetings? Then welcome to Berg. We have troubles enough in the lands around us; perhaps you can help with them.
